verdict: Wynn's revenue fell 8% to $1.7B as softer Macau demand, an unlucky Las Vegas hold and a Boston strike cut property profit by nearly a fifth.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: diluted, attributable to Wynn Resorts, vs $0.85 a year ago

kpis.label: Las Vegas Operations revenue
kpis.note: -7% YoY, hurt by a low hold rate

segments.name: Wynn Palace
segments.note: The Cotai, Macau resort — Wynn's largest property by revenue; casino revenue fell as Macau demand softened.

segments.name: Wynn Macau
segments.note: The original Macau peninsula resort and its Encore expansion.

segments.name: Las Vegas Operations
segments.note: Wynn Las Vegas, Encore and the retail joint venture — revenue also hurt by a table-games hold rate outside the expected range.

segments.name: Encore Boston Harbor
segments.note: The Everett, Massachusetts resort — operations were disrupted by a strike that began in early September.

opex.name: General and administrative
opex.note: Corporate and property overhead, including stock-based compensation and the triple-net lease cost for the Las Vegas land.

opex.name: Depreciation and amortization
opex.note: Spreading the cost of the resorts, furnishings and equipment over their working lives.

opex.name: Property charges and other
opex.note: Property charges and other items — up from $6M a year ago.

opex.name: Pre-opening
opex.note: Costs of preparing new projects, mainly Wynn Al Marjan Island in the UAE (planned to open September 2027), including equity-method losses.

otherDetail: Other income (expense), net was -$136M: interest expense of $152M and a $5M loss on debt financing, partly offset by $13M of interest income and a $10M gain on derivatives. A further $19M of consolidated profit belonged to noncontrolling interests (mainly the minority holders of Wynn Macau), leaving $17M attributable to Wynn Resorts shareholders.
oneTimers: Las Vegas results were hurt by a table-games hold rate outside the expected range, and Encore Boston Harbor operated through a strike that began in early September — neither effect is separately quantified in the release.
Adjusted net income attributable to Wynn Resorts was $33.9M, or $0.33 per diluted share (non-GAAP), versus GAAP EPS of $0.17.

takeaways.title: All four properties shrank
takeaways.text: Revenue fell at every property — Wynn Palace -$52M, Las Vegas -$46M, Wynn Macau -$30M and Encore Boston Harbor -$17M versus a year ago — as Macau demand softened.

takeaways.title: Property profit fell nearly a fifth
takeaways.text: Adjusted Property EBITDAR dropped 19% to $464M from $570M, with the biggest dollar declines in Las Vegas (-$45M) and at Wynn Palace (-$35M).

takeaways.title: Dividend held, UAE build continues
takeaways.text: The board declared a $0.25 per-share dividend payable November 30, 2026, and finishing work continues at Wynn Al Marjan Island ahead of its planned September 2027 opening.

footerNote: Chart layout adapts Wynn's printed statement: direct property costs (casino $674M, rooms $83M, food and beverage $226M, entertainment, retail and other $50M, and the $9M provision for credit losses — $1,043M in total) form the direct-cost block; casino costs include $459M of gaming taxes. Figures are converted from the 10-Q's thousands to $M. Net income in the chart is the $17M attributable to Wynn Resorts, Limited: consolidated net income was $37M, of which $19M belonged to noncontrolling interests (shown in the Other income line). Wynn filed its Q3 2026 results on November 5, 2026, so no fallback to Q2 was needed.
